acl2025.interpretation: Descriptive within-source paired comparisons against the shared quality baseline. Only papers with every selected version present in both conditions contribute. Each contributing paper has equal weight. Native OA differences are arithmetic summaries of ordinal codes, not calibrated effect sizes. No scores are pooled across sources. This selected pilot has one replicate per cell and no human validation, confidence intervals, significance tests, or causal identification. Score equality does not establish absence of framing sensitivity; text equality checks are not semantic assessments.
